findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The history fixture has three cold-read rounds and an approval, but no merged part. Its assertions stop at the approval line, so removing the renderer’s merged-part history entries would leave this named proof passing. The Done-when item explicitly requires merged parts after approval.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The section test asserts that long Stories starts folded and short Fixes starts open, but never asserts the required initial open state of Overview or Roadmap. The browser check toggles each fold relative to whatever state it started in, so removing either default `open` attribute would not fail this proof.
